name: Hotel Costanero Montevideo - MGallery
desc: Right in Montevideo, by Pocitos Bay, Costanero Montevideo is a boutique hotel designed for memorable experiences. Its uniquely designed rooms are perfect for relaxing with sea views. Also with Cauce's locally influenced international cuisine, and Bar Cauce, with flavors and aromas offering a unique sensory experience. Take advantage of the meeting rooms andwellness area with swimming pool, gym and sauna.

name: Sofitel Montevideo Casino Carrasco and Spa
desc: Discover Sofitel Montevideo Casino Carrasco & Spa, combining French elegance and Uruguayan charm. In the exclusive Carrasco neighborhood, our iconic beachfront hotel combines historic architecture with contemporary luxury. Enjoy refined rooms, exquisite gastronomy, a world-class spa and vibrant Casino. Personal service and great comfort makes it a memorable experience. Book and experience it for yourself.

name: Mercure Montevideo Punta Carretas
desc: The Mercure Montevideo Punta Carretas is sophisticated, with a privileged location in the Uruguayan capital. Air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI and bay or city view options. The restaurant offers a full breakfast using homemade and local products. If you have meetings and conferences, use the modern Gauguin Room, and if you need to work quietly, visit the business center.

name: ibis Montevideo Rambla
desc: Perfect for business, family, or leisure stays, ibis Montevideo Rambla offers air-conditioned rooms with minibar, free WIFI and large, comfy beds. Dine at ibis Kitchen, serving top international dishes and homemade treats. The bar features drinks and a kids' menu. The café is open 24/7. Use the event rooms and business center. Private, secure parking is available for a charge.
address: Calle La Cumparsita 1473, Rambla República Argentina

name: ibis Styles Montevideo Biarritz
desc: If you are looking for a budget hotel in Montevideo, visit our ibis Styles Montevideo Biarritz. The ideal hotel for all those looking for comfort, modernity, location and price. This hotel offers guests the perfect structure and support for an incredible stay. It also has a fabulous restaurant with delicious dishes and an excellent cost-benefit ratio, so book and visit us!
